items.title: fix(channels): send pairing approvals from the approved account (#137…
items.summary: fix(channels): send pairing approvals from the approved account (#137268) * fix(channels): send pairing approvals from the approved account The pairing approval contract carries the account a request was selected on, but the LINE, Signal, IRC, and Synology Chat notifiers dropped it and resolved the default account instead. On a multi-account setup the approval went out from the wrong account with the wrong credentials while the gateway still reported the notification as sent. Each of the four notifiers now passes the approved account id to its account resolver. Omitting the account id still resolves the default account exactly as before. * fix(channels): extend account-scoped pairing approvals to Zalo, Zalo Personal, and iMessage The Zalo, Zalo Personal (zalouser), and iMessage pairing notifiers dropped the approved account id the same way the first four did, so on a multi-account setup the approval went out from the default account. Each notifier now passes the approved account id to its account resolver or sender, and the Zalo and iMessage runtime facades type their params with an optional accountId so the id survives the module boundary. Omitting the account id still resolves the default account exactly as before. * fix(channels): reuse account-aware pairing notification senders Preserve the approved account across all seven affected plugins. Reuse existing delivery owners for iMessage, Synology Chat, and Zalo so failed notifications remain visible and Zalo retains its account proxy. Keep the existing notification text and completed approval unchanged. Production decreases by five lines. Secretless hosted proof covers all seven original account mismatches, real notifier HTTP effects, 204 focused checks, and exact candidate file hashes. Co-authored-by: MarMar Labs * fix(imessage): preserve pairing approval welcome text Use the shared approval message already sent by the removed notifier. Assert the exact RPC text for both selected and default accounts. Hosted proof reproduced both generic-text regressions on a2014d63c19, then passed all 15 iMessage owner tests and verified all 16 candidate file hashes after this correction. Co-authored-by: MarMar Labs --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: MarMar Labs

items.title: 【AI轉型實例】玉山金打造AI智能徵信流程，7分鐘生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時
items.summary: 徵信調查是風險控管的核心，玉山銀行企業放款餘額超過1兆元，每年玉山法金部門都會重新審視往來企業的信用和財務狀況。不過，傳統法金徵信作業最大痛點是，資料散亂和人工作業耗時。數百名負責徵信作業的客戶關係經理（RM），一年得要撰寫四、五千份徵信報告，每月高達4成的工時都花在蒐集資料上。 玉山銀行花了一年，自行開發了「iCatcher」與智能徵信報告工具「智捷通」等多款AI工具，將授信作業流程中動輒耗費十多小時的資料蒐集及報告初稿製作工作，縮短至分鐘級，推估一年可以節省8.4萬個人時。
